rows.original_synopsis_draft: After Orion pirates steal crucial medicine, the crew must recover it to save Spock.
The Enterprise computer begins playing elaborate tricks on its crew after showing signs of sentience.
The Enterprise locates an explorer who had been missing for years.
Radiation exposure causes members of the Enterprise crew to shrink in size.
Cyrano Jones introduces an unusual kind of tribble that cannot reproduce.
While preparing to meet hostile Romulans, the crew discovers a vessel carrying three frozen people from the twentieth century.
Q challenges the Enterprise again, tempting Riker with extraordinary abilities in return for joining the continuum.
A rescue operation ends in tragedy when a hostile alien kills an Enterprise officer.
Worf's convictions are shaken by the apparent return of a legendary Klingon warrior.
Called back to his creator, Data comes into conflict with his brother Lore.
Picard offers protection to a visiting scientist who wants to escape a ritual death required by his culture.
Picard seeks communication with a dangerous entity before a visiting scientist destroys it.
Worf confronts the difficulties of fatherhood when his son Alexander joins him aboard the Enterprise.
A young survivor of a destroyed vessel begins to imitate Data.
Odo's feelings for Kira complicate his assignment protecting a Bajoran leader who is also drawn to her.
